title: Codo

description.en: A quiet macOS notification bridge between your AI agents and your desktop.
description.zh: 连接 AI 智能体与桌面的 macOS 通知桥梁，支持菜单栏服务和命令行。

subject: Vivid faceted hummingbird hovering at one coral bell flower

source.description: macOS menubar notification daemon and CLI — bridge for Claude Code and AI agents

subject.en: Vivid faceted hummingbird hovering at one coral bell flower
subject.zh: 色彩鲜明的切面蜂鸟悬停在一朵珊瑚色钟形花旁

description.en: A complete hummingbird pauses with its beak at one bell flower. Both wings, the tail and small feet remain visible with generous corner clearance.
description.zh: 完整的小蜂鸟将鸟喙停在一朵钟形花旁，双翼、尾羽和小脚都清晰可见，并为圆角留足空间。

title.en: Emerald, then a flash of color

description.en: The owner requested vivid colors: emerald and teal lead, with violet wings, coral and gold on the breast, and one flower beside the beak. Connected facets keep the bird readable.
description.zh: 依照本轮鲜明色彩的要求，以翡翠绿和青色为主，配紫色翼面、珊瑚与金色胸羽及一朵小花。相连切面维持蜂鸟的清晰轮廓。

description.en: Large unequal petal impressions curl through a muted teal field. Soft grain and a shallow shadow keep the richly colored wings distinct.
description.zh: 大小不一的花瓣压纹弯过柔和青色底纹，细颗粒与浅阴影让丰富翼色保持分明。

palette.source: Selected Codo presentation, 2026-09-07-01/01; background.base in archived settings.json

sizeNote.en: The complete animal and accessory have at least 149.94 px clearance from the actual rounded outline. Ten export sizes preserve one uniform placement. Small app/browser marks use the transparent foreground; fine facets and accessory details simplify at 16 px.
sizeNote.zh: 完整动物和兴趣点距离真实圆角轮廓至少 149.94 px。十种导出尺寸保持同一组等比位置，小型 UI 与浏览器使用透明主体；细小切面和装饰细节在 16 px 时会简化。

goal.en: Deliver local script and Claude Code events as Mac desktop banners, keep project and session history, and optionally summarize notifications with an AI Guardian.
goal.zh: 将本地脚本和 Claude Code 事件显示为 Mac 桌面横幅，保存项目与会话记录，并按需使用 AI Guardian 整理通知。

role.zh: 命令行与 Guardian 进程

description.en: Three asymmetric petal pockets and fine, offset seams echo the bell flower beside the hummingbird.
description.zh: 三片不对称的花瓣与细细错开的接缝，呼应蜂鸟身旁的钟形花。

alt.en: Vivid faceted hummingbird hovering at one coral bell flower on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 色彩鲜明的切面蜂鸟悬停在一朵珊瑚色钟形花旁，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

caption.en: A small signal, right on time.

description.en: Vivid faceted hummingbird hovering at one coral bell flower.
description.zh: 色彩鲜明的切面蜂鸟悬停在一朵珊瑚色钟形花旁。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥63px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 63px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
